reference_policy: Legacy artwork is a finish/material reference only. The accepted v2 lobby is the projection, palette, line-weight and value anchor.
shared_constraints: Strict flat frontal side elevation / dollhouse room side view; camera perpendicular to the back wall; level horizontal character baseline; no bird's-eye, top-down, isometric, three-quarter, receding floor, vanishing point, perspective grid, camera tilt, photorealism, 3D render, text, UI, routes, characters, clues, logos or watermark. Full-bleed medium-bright art with clean dark ink contours, flat color blocks, only two or three cel-shading values and restrained paper grain.
local_edit_policy: Generated masters stay immutable in source/generated. Alpha extraction and exact module resize/assembly are recorded revisions in source/edited. Final frozen inputs live in source/selected.

room-stable-base.prompt: Apply shared_constraints. Ancient Chinese inn stable, square 3x3 room: frontal stall partition, tack, feed trough and restrained straw; clear lower character band; quiet side edges; no doors or people.
